AddTotemExp.Name: Scarred Shadow Essence
Text: Scarred Shadow Essence
A prop used to raise the level of the Imprint, the Imprint will gain 1 EXP after use
Click 'Upgrade' to use it in the interface of the Imprint system. If the quantity is sufficient, it will be upgraded directly, if the quantity is insufficient, it will get the corresponding EXP.
Essence extracted from the Imprint, can provide energy for the Imprint's upgrading
Note: Can be put into Carrying bank

AptitudeItem01.Name: Low-grade Spirituality Pill
Text: Low-grade Spirituality Pill
When the Imprint's Spirituality level is 0, 1, or 2, you can use a Low-grade Spirituality Pill to raise it. (Right click to use it on the Imprint)

When raising the Spirituality, there is a certain chance to fail, and the failure will lower the Spirituality of the Imprint, when the Spirituality is 4,7,9, the failure does not lower the Spirituality.
Note: Can be put into Carrying bank

AptitudeItem02.Name: Intermediate Spirituality Pill
Text: Intermediate Spirituality Pill
When the Imprint's Spirituality level is 3, 4, or 5, you can use the Intermediate Spirituality Pill to raise the Spirituality level. (Right click to use it on the Imprint)

When raising the Spirituality, there is a certain chance to fail, and the failure will lower the Spirituality of the Imprint, when the Spirituality is 4,7,9, the failure does not lower the Spirituality.
Note: Can be put into Carrying bank

AptitudeItem03.Name: Advanced Spirituality Pill
Text: Advanced Spirituality Pill
When the Imprint's Spirituality level is 6, 7, 8, or 9, you can use the Advanced Spirituality Pill to raise the Spirituality level. (Right click to use it on the imprint)

When raising the Spirituality, there is a certain chance to fail, and the failure will lower the Spirituality of the Imprint, when the Spirituality is 4,7,9, the failure does not lower the Spirituality.
Note: Can be put into Carrying bank

After a successful transfer, the equipment that originally had the transferred attribute will disappear.

MetempsychosisRing.Name: Ocean Heart
Text: Because of your past
Loneness left quietly.
Because of your past
Happiness arrives.
This Deep-sea Heart
Witness us!

MetempsychosisRing2.Name: Diamond Wedding Ring
Text: The happiness bell rings
Put on love rings
Wish you a sweet life!

MetempsychosisRing3.Name: Gold Wedding Ring
Text: This Gold Ring
Witness us!

MetempsychosisRing4.Name: Phantasy Star
Text: Let the dead have the immortality of the name
Let the living have eternal love
Love is life in its fullness
Like the cup with its wine

MetempsychosisRing5.Name: Allure of Love
Text: I remember that wonderful moment ,
You appeared in front of me.
This amazing and wonderful moment,
Like the beautiful and holy Venus.

MetempsychosisRing6.Name: Love of Moon
Text: I will take the moon's gentleness, and the star's light, along the Milky way, enters your dream.

MetempsychosisRing7.Name: Mysterious whisper
Text: Under the vast and boundless sky
We held tight and felt each other's breath
Light, rapid and enchanting
Flash, eternal, like a shooting star

MetempsychosisRing8.Name: Dazzling Lover
Text: Last night, you break into my dream
As dazzling as that night long time ago
This morning,I woke up empty
Embrace all of you in my dreams
My memory is inscribed with your name permanently

Timeback.Name: Essence Stone
Text: A mysterious stone that can help you keep a record of a refinement stat of any weapon, piece of clothing, helmet, or figurehead. When the equipment is upgraded or when the stats are transferred, the recorded stat will be lost.

Totem000001.Name: Tiger Imprint
Text: TheTiger Imprint symbolizes the ferocious tiger, whose sharp claws can easily tear apart animals, so the Fierce Tiger Imprint has a significant bonus to the Imprint's Bleeding damage.

Totem000002.Name: Eagle Imprint
Text: The Eagle Imprint symbolizes the soaring eagle, whose sharp beak captures animals with precision, so the Eagle Imprint has a significant bonus to the Imprint's Piercing damage.

Totem000003.Name: Mammoth Imprint
Text: The Mammoth Imprint symbolizes the thick mammoth, whose thick hide effectively defends against tearing attacks, so the Mammoth Imprint has a significant bonus to the Imprint's Bleeding defense.

Totem000004.Name: Dragon Turtle Imprint
Text: The Dragon Turtle Imprint symbolizes the thick Dragon Turtle, whose sturdy armor can easily withstand piercing attacks, so the Dragon Turtle Imprint has a significant bonus to the Imprint's Piercing defense.

Totem000005.Name: Monkey Imprint
Text: The Monkey Imprint symbolizes the agility of apes and monkeys, due to their almost human like super intelligence, have a strong perception of various types of damage,so the Monkey Imprint has a significant bonus to increase or reduce the Imprint's damage .

Upgradecard.Name: Material Upgrade Card
Text: Upgraded Salvation set materials can be exchanged for Fallen set materials, or upgraded Fallen set materials can be exchanged for Inquisitor's set materials at Trípoli Port.

VIP0001.Name: Polar Tundra Explore Certificate
Text: Players may enter the Polar Tundra(Ordinary)and the Polar Tundra(Elite) areas twice a day after they use this item once. The instances give players the chance to obtain extra Profession EXP.The same item may not be duplicated.

VIP0002.Name: King's Tomb Explore Certificate
Text: Players may enter the King's Tomb(Ordinary) and King's Tomb(Elite) areas twice a day after they use this item once. The instances give players the chance to obtain extra Profession EXP.The same item may not be duplicated.

VIP003.Name: Poseidon Temple Exploration Certificate
Text: Increases the cap of entering the Poseidon Hall instance by 2 every day and increases the class experience in the instance by 50%. This effect can't be stacked up with other item that has same effect.

VIP004.Name: Portobello Exploration Certificate
Text: With this item, one can enter the Portobello Downtown Instance an additional two times a day and receive 50% more EXP in the Instance. This effect does not stack if you own multiple copies of this item.

VIP005.Name: Battled Forest Exploration Proof
Text: Increases the cap of entering Battled Forest instance by 1 everyday and increases the profession experience in the instance by 50%. This effect cannot be stacked with another item of the same effect.

renshenseed01.Name: Ginseng Seed [lower]
Text: Adult wild ginseng seeds, short cultivation and growth cycle [5 minutes].
1. Go to the planting base to cultivate can get ginseng [lower] (planting base can be obtained from the Grocer in the camp)
2. The start of high quality ginseng, whose plants have a chance to obtain ginseng seeds [medium]
3. After the plant matures, everyone can harvest it. Not saved after leaving the Desire World

renshenseed02.Name: Ginseng Seed [Medium]
Text: Excellent ginseng seeds, cultivated for a slightly longer growth cycle [7 minutes]
1.Go to the planting base to cultivate can get ginseng [Medium] (planting base can be obtained from the Grocer in the camp)
2. Its plant has a chance to get ginseng seeds [Top]
3. After the plant matures, everyone can harvest it. Not saved after leaving the Desire World

renshenseed03.Name: Ginseng Seed [top]

2. Its plants have a chance to get ginseng seeds [rare]
3. After the plant matures, everyone can harvest it. Not saved after leaving the Desire World

renshenseed04.Name: Ginseng Seed [Rare]
Text: The seeds of rare ginseng, cultivated for a long growth cycle [20 minutes]
1.  Go to the planting base to cultivate can get ginseng [rare] (planting base can be obtained from the Grocer in the camp)
2. Its plants have not yet been found to produce rare seeds.
3. After the plant matures, everyone can harvest it. Not saved after leaving the Desire World
